Sugarcane.note: Split N into 3 doses: basal, 45 DAP, 90 DAP.

Cotton.note: Apply full P & K as basal; split N in 2-3 doses.

Soybean.note: Low N (legume fixes its own); higher P for nodulation.

Onion.note: Avoid chloride-based potash near bulb maturity.

Wheat.note: Apply half N + full P & K at sowing, rest N at first irrigation.

Maize.note: Top dress N at knee-high and tasseling stages.
